# DabWave Hue Ramps — Proposed Catalog

**Status: Proposed (DAB-016).** Not approved. Values are generated by
`scripts/hue-catalog.mjs` and must not be consumed until DAB-016 is ratified.

Thirteen steps, shared with the ratified gray step names. The formula uses the
fixed L ladder and chroma curve below; base chroma is 85% of the maximum
in-gamut chroma at step 600 for each hue. Steps 0 and 1000 are pure white and
black. `gray-150` is intentionally absent (DAB-004).

| Step | L | C curve |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 1.000 | 0.00 |
| 50 | 0.970 | 0.10 |
| 100 | 0.940 | 0.18 |
| 200 | 0.880 | 0.32 |
| 300 | 0.810 | 0.52 |
| 400 | 0.730 | 0.74 |
| 500 | 0.640 | 0.92 |
| 600 | 0.560 | 1.00 |
| 700 | 0.480 | 0.96 |
| 800 | 0.400 | 0.86 |
| 900 | 0.320 | 0.70 |
| 950 | 0.220 | 0.45 |
| 1000 | 0.000 | 0.00 |
